item.title: Indonesia Was Finding Its Feet. Then Came MSCI
item.description: The latest blow to Indonesia, from MSCI Inc.’s warning it’s considering removing the country from its global indexes, couldn’t have come at a worst time. Southeast Asia's largest economy appeared to be finding its feet after a rocky few years. Now, it faces an exodus of international capital.

item.title: Jio Platforms IPO listing: Can Reliance overtake Tata Group as India’s largest conglomerate by market cap? Details
item.description: A potential Jio Platforms IPO, valued at about ₹10.3 lakh crore, could lift Reliance Group’s combined market capitalisation to ₹28.35 lakh crore, overtaking Tata Group’s ₹25.92 lakh crore. Adani ranks third at ₹17.23 lakh crore, followed by HDFC Group at nearly ₹13.9 lakh crore.

item.title: Already a hit? Reliance's Jio Platforms gets ₹8,110 cr from anchor investors; LIC, New World Fund among top investors
item.description: Jio Platforms allotted shares worth ₹8,110 crore to 212 anchor investors at ₹1,119 per share ahead of its October 21 IPO. LIC received the largest allocation. The company aims to raise about ₹30,213 crore, valuing it at approximately $108 billion at the top of its price band.

item.title: What’s wrong with Indonesian stock market? Why it lost nearly 40% in a year and can Jakarta win back investors? Decoded
item.description: Indonesia’s stock market has lost nearly 40% this year after MSCI warned it could downgrade the country to standalone status, citing concerns over transparency and trading practices. The move risks billions in foreign outflows, putting pressure on Jakarta to strengthen regulations.

item.title: Reliance Jio IPO: 'Salute Mukesh Ambani' - Ace investor Manish Chokhani on '500 mn customers, $100 bn valuation
item.description: Jio Platforms’ IPO will open October 21, with a price band of ₹1,065– ₹1,119 per share. The fresh issue could raise about ₹30,213 crore, making it India’s largest IPO. The offering has reportedly drawn strong interest from global and domestic institutional investors.

item.title: $10.5 billion worth of shares! SpaceX boss Elon Musk to give one share to every US child — how many shares does he own?
item.description: Elon Musk says he plans to give every child in the United States one SpaceX share next year. He has not explained eligibility or how shares would be transferred to minors. With about 72 million US children under 18, the shares could be worth roughly $10.5 billion at Friday’s closing price.

item.title: Manic Monday at Indian stock market: Sensex, Nifty bleed - ₹3.6 lakh cr gone in 6 hours | What went wrong? Big reasons
item.description: Indian stocks fell sharply on Monday, with the Nifty 50 down 1.11% and Sensex down 1.17%, as disappointing private-bank earnings, weak global cues and profit-taking in IT shares weighed on sentiment. BSE-listed companies lost ₹3.6 lakh crore in market value.

item.title: Reliance-backed Jio Platforms IPO: Will investors prefer Jio shares over RIL stock? What shareholders should know
item.description: Jio Platforms plans to launch its IPO from 21 to 23 October 2026, offering shares at ₹1,065– ₹1,119 and seeking about ₹30,213 crore. Proceeds will mainly reduce debt. Investors will weigh Jio’s focused digital and telecom growth against RIL’s diversified businesses, valuation and risk profile.

item.title: IDBI Bank shares delivered almost no returns in 20 years. Can Fairfax deal finally turn stock around? Experts weigh in
item.description: IDBI Bank shares remain near their 2006 level despite a privatisation-driven rally. Fairfax Financial has agreed to buy a 60.72% stake for about ₹53,000 cr, subject to regulatory nod. Analysts cite potential long-term benefits but warn of volatility, valuation risks and need for stronger earnings.
